nom: Beekman 1802 Potato Peel Rapid Resurfacing Milk Facial

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily/resistant skin describe the peel as gentle but effective enough to wear overnight, including alongside retinoids and other acids.
segments.dry: One reviewer contrasts her oily/resistant skin with dry/sensitive skin, implying the latter should use it only as a weekly short peel rather than overnight; another reports it did not dry out or crack her skin.
segments.combination: A reviewer with sensitive, combination skin reports no negative issues despite a scent and slight sting on application.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers repeatedly describe themselves as very or extremely sensitive and report only mild, brief tingling or stinging, with most saying it did not irritate their skin, though a few note stinging when layering moisturizer after.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 70s, including one managing rosacea with papules and pimples, report smoother, brighter skin and softened fine lines, with one advised to build up wear time gradually.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report brighter skin, improved elasticity, and less noticeable fine lines, including one who felt a firming sensation after repeated use.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the product left skin soft and smooth without dryness or cracking, and that moisturizer absorbed better afterward.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea accompanied by papules and pimples found it beneficial when introduced gradually, starting at very short wear times.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers with sensitive skin report no burning or irritation and easy tolerance even at full wear time, though one reviewer noted a residual smell and texture she found off-putting.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark spots, hyperpigmentation, and more even, brighter tone; one noted her skin turned noticeably lighter overall, which she welcomed but flagged as strong.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers managing acne and cystic acne scars report smaller, less noticeable marks and fewer breakouts over repeated use; one reviewer saw no visible improvement after multiple uses.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily, resistant skin report the product controls texture and tightens the look of pores without stripping the skin.

aspects.libelle: Small bottle size relative to price
Works well layered with other Beekman products
No visible results for some users

extraits.titre: Great product that does exactly what it says.
extraits.texte: I purchased this during a sale to try & I'm so glad that I did. It's a great facial peel that I use once a week to brighten & soften my skin. I use it at night after washing my face & leave it on for about 30 minutes, then rinse off & put on a heavy moisturizer to sleep in. I have sensitive, combination skin & I haven't had any negative issues. Like some of the comments say, it does have a smell & it can sting a bit when you apply it, but I'm ok with that because I prefer natural ingredients that do what they say rather than some product full of fragrances.

I can't imagine how extremely dry and sensitive your skin would have to be to only use this as a weekly 10 minute peel instead of a daily overnight peel! It even works well with retinoids! My skin is oily, resistant, and used to acids. My face has always been very soft and smooth – but it has recently become seriously coarse and leathery due to illness… so I wore this all night every night for a week, and it's already so much better! I'm still wearing it every night, and it's incredibly gentle – but still effective! It doesn't cause the least bit of stinging, burning, or discomfort like a real chemical peel.
Wors great on my daughters face. She has eczema and very sensitive skin and she loves it

I was lucky enough to purchase this product at the Beekman 1802 Store in Sharon Springs, NY. The sales person there was exceedingly helpful when I asked her about skin care products for a 70 year-old woman with rosacea accompanied by papules and pimples. She recommended the Potato Peel to me and stressed that I should be very careful how long I leave it on at first because of my sensitive skin. She recommended 2 minutes to see how my skin tolerated it. I am now up to 5 minutes and find it extremely beneficial to my overall skin health. The sales rep also recommended Smooth Booster with willow bark and I find that it really helps those fine lines above my upper lip. I have used Eminence products for years, but I think I will be trying more Beekman 1802 products in the future.
